title: onobrychis alba var. striatula
intro: Onobrychis alba var. striatula, commonly known as White Spanish Clover, is a variety of the Onobrychis alba plant, which is a type of legume. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Onobrychis alba var. striatula are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and calm the nervous system. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various conditions, including fever, cough, and gastrointestinal problems, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
